يمتدحون (form VIII)
# يَمْتَدِحُونَ (yamtadiḥūna) /jam.ta.di.ħuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِمْتَدَحَ (imtadaḥa)
# يُمْتَدَحُونَ (yumtadaḥūna) /jum.ta.da.ħuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَدَحَ (imtadaḥa)
